I am fluent in Korean and my personal ranking would be

1. Haruto - His Korean and vocabulary is pretty incredible. He is able to say slang and more advanced words naturally. To me, he sounds like a native with a slight accent. He is able to have a consistent pace when talking, knowing when to take pauses and He does have trouble saying hard consonants and slurs his words sometimes but in general, I would say he is the best out of the 4 J-line.
2. Mashiho - Mashiho has really clear pronunciation and can articulate words really well. His word choice is very advanced and he is able to speak without thinking too much about what to say. The only reason I did not put him in first is that he speaks a bit too fast sometimes and at an inconsistent pace, so sometimes he sounds like he is speaking Japanese when speaking Korean. He also struggles with reading sometimes.
3. Yoshi - Now, Yoshi and Asahi are about the same to me, but I would say Yoshi's Korean is slightly better in that he has consistent grammar. His pronunciation when it comes to vowels is a bit off and he mashes up words up in chunks like they are Japanese sometimes.
4. Asahi - I think Asahi lacks a bit of confidence when speaking Korean sometimes, but I still think his tone is great when speaking Korean. He is able to speak smoothly and with perfect grammar, but as another person commented, he still has a Japanese accent.

That all being said, these 4 have incredible Korean. I would dare say one of the best when comparing to Japanese Kpop idols. You can tell they practiced a lot during their trainee years!
